services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to complex removals, we handle every aspect of tree care with safety and precision.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled felling of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle site clearance and stump grinding, leaving your garden ready for replanting.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin out overgrown branches to restore light, reduce weight, and improve tree health. Perfect for trees blocking views or threatening nearby structures.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Remove diseased, dead, or weak branches that pose safety risks. Regular deadwood removal prevents limbs falling onto property and neighbours.

services.title: Tree Felling & Site Clearance
services.desc: Large-scale tree removal with full site clearance, stump removal, and chipping. Ideal for building projects, land clearing, or storm damage recovery.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Keep hedges healthy and tidy with seasonal cutting. We work to conservation standards and respect nesting birds throughout the year.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Storm brought a tree down? We attend same-day emergency call-outs to make dangerous trees safe and clear fallen debris from your property.

about_pullquote: We climb the trees others won't touch—safely and fairly priced.
about_para_1: Arborforce Tree Specialist was founded on a simple belief: every tree deserves expert, honest care. For over 15 years, we've been removing, pruning, and maintaining trees across Newcastle and Northumberland. Our team holds NPTC qualifications and full arboricultural insurance, so you can rest assured every job—from routine pruning to major felling—meets the highest standards.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation by turning up on time, explaining the work clearly, and charging fair prices. Our customers—homeowners, property managers, and developers—trust us because we treat their gardens like our own. Whether a branch is threatening your roof or you need an overgrown oak thinned before winter, we get it done right.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Arborforce

reviews.text: Had a massive oak hanging over the garage after the storm. Arborforce came out the same day, assessed it properly, and felled it without a scratch on the house. Tidy, professional, fair price. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: They've been pruning our cherry trees for three years now. Always on time, always explain what they're doing, and the garden looks brilliant afterwards. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah H.

reviews.text: Removed two diseased conifers and ground out the stumps. Excellent work, very professional team, and they left the garden spotless. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: David W.
